post.summary: Opens a session with an e-mail or a username and a password.
Signs an app in with an e-mail or a username and a password.
Trades a refresh token for a new bearer token and refresh token.
Creates an account, signs it in and sends its verification e-mail.
Verifies an e-mail with the parameters of the link sent to it.
Sends the verification e-mail of the signed-in account again.
Sends a link setting a new password, if an account uses the e-mail.
Sets a new password with the parameters of the link sent by e-mail.

get.summary: Sends the browser to Google, to come back signed in.

parameters.name: ReturnUrl
parameters.description:
The page to come back to: a path of the site, or a URL of its origin. The profile page
otherwise.

parameters.name: Locale
parameters.description: Locale of the pages to come back to, such as `fr`.

parameters.name: RememberMe
parameters.description: Keeps the session for 30 days rather than until the browser closes.

post.summary: Signs an app in with the code of a Google sign-in, redeemed here.

get.summary: Minimum and latest version of each app.

AbilitySlot.description: The five abilities of a champion, in the order of its page.

poster.description: The frame shown before the video plays (JPEG).

AbilityVideo.description: The looping preview of one ability, in two formats and with its still frame.

oneOf.description: The signed-in account; null for a visitor.

AccountSession.description:
The session of the caller: its account, or none. The sign-in and the registration answer
it too, so that a front needs no second call.

riotTagline.description: The Riot tag line shown after the username, such as `EUW`.

emailVerified.description: Whether the e-mail is verified, which some actions require.

hasPassword.description: False for an account created through Google, which signs in there.

twoFactorEnabled.description: Whether a sign-in with the password also asks for an authenticator code.

multiFactor.description: Whether this session was opened with a second factor, which the admin area requires.

roles.description: Roles of the account, such as `Admin`.

AccountUser.description: The signed-in account, as the fronts show it.

AppPolicy.description: `GET /api/client-policy`: the policy of every app, one entry each.

webpUrl.description: `/cdn/blobs/{sha256}.webp`; null for a placeholder or a non-PNG.

CatalogImage.description: An image as a client renders it: its blob and WebP sibling, or a placeholder.

latest.description: The version the site and the apps open on; null until the first ingestion completes.

versions.description: Every version Data Dragon lists, newest first, the long tail included.

readyVersions.description: The versions ingested ahead of any visit, newest first.

versionPattern.description: Regular expression a version matches, anchors excluded.

languages.description: Every Data Dragon language, such as en_US.

languagePattern.description: Regular expression a language matches, anchors excluded.

defaultLanguage.description: The language every version ships, which the others fall back to.

locales.description: The interface locales and the Data Dragon language each one reads.

fallbackLocale.description: The locale of a visitor whose preference matches none.

gameModes.description: The modes a build targets, each with the map that gates its items.

CatalogMeta.description: Everything the front lists without hard-coding it: versions, languages, locales, modes.

id.description: Data Dragon spell id, such as AhriQ; null for the passive.

description.description: Riot's rich text, unresolved template tokens removed.

range.description: Per-rank range; null when missing or a placeholder value.

oneOf.description: The preview, which may not exist: the page falls back to the icon.

ChampionAbility.description: The passive or a spell of a champion, with its preview video.

ChampionArt.description: The three arts of a skin, hotlinked from Data Dragon rather than ingested (UP 8).

id.description: Public id, such as MonkeyKing: the page and the art are keyed by it.

tags.description: Roles, as Data Dragon names them ("Mage").

partype.description: The resource as the catalog's language names it.

ChampionCard.description:
A champion as the list shows it, with the values its facets filter on: roles, resource,
range, ratings and base stats.

label.description: The colour family the swatch reads as ("Ruby"), "Chroma" when unknown.

ChampionChroma.description: A chroma of a skin, its swatch hotlinked from CommunityDragon (UP 9).

canonicalPath.description: The page the routing redirects a stale or slugless URL to.

profile.description: The facts of the list's card.

abilities.description: The passive, then the spells in their Q, W, E, R order.

ChampionDetails.description:
`GET /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}/champions/{id}`: the card, then the lore, the
abilities and the skins, every image resolved and every art hotlinked.

ChampionFacets.description:
The facet options the data decides, over the whole list; the fixed ones (range classes)
are enums of the contract.

contentLanguage.description: The language the entries are written in, en_US after a fallback.

total.description: Entries of the whole list, whatever the page.

ChampionOption.description: A champion the favorite and build pickers offer.

ChampionRatings.description: Riot's 0-10 ratings of a champion (`info` in the dataset).

id.description: Data Dragon skin id, such as 103001.

number.description: Number of the skin's art, 0 for the base skin.

name.description: Display name: the base skin reads as the champion.

ChampionSkin.description: A skin of the champion, chroma entries left out, with its art and chromas.

perLevel.description:
Gain per level, as Data Dragon writes it (a percentage for the attack speed); null for
the stats that do not grow.

ChampionStat.description: A base stat of a champion at level 1, and what it gains per level.

ClientPlatform.description: The apps the policy governs; the web, always current, is none of them.

canonicalPath.description: Its page; null when this catalog does not carry the twin.

CounterpartLink.description:
The same-named item or summoner spell of the other game (UP 6): "Faerie Charm" is both
1004 and the Classic 771004.

Edition.description: Game an item or a summoner spell belongs to: today's League of Legends, or LoL Classic.

alreadyVerified.description: Whether an earlier click of the link verified it: a link stays valid for its hour.

canonicalPath.description: Its page, such as `items/1036-long-sword`, under the locale prefix.

oneOf.description: For an item, which game it belongs to; twins share their name.

EntityLink.description: Another entry a page links to: a recipe component, an upgrade, a bound champion.

email.description: The e-mail of the account, whatever the case.

oneOf.description: Locale of the e-mail; the fallback locale when unset.

GameMode.description: Game modes a build can target, each bound to the map that gates its items.

GameModeMap.description: A game mode and the Data Dragon map id that gates its items.

GameStat.description: The game attributes the encyclopedia surfaces (champion base stats, item stat blocks).

code.description: The authorization code Google handed to the redirect URI.

codeVerifier.description: The PKCE verifier whose challenge the app sent to Google.

redirectUri.description: The redirect URI the app sent to Google, as sent.

clientId.description: The Google client the app signed in with; the web client when unset.

GoogleExchangeRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/account/google/app/exchange`: what an app got from a Google
sign-in in the system browser, with PKCE.

edition.description: Which game the item belongs to: 1004 and 771004 share a name.

oneOf.description: The same-named item of the other game, when there is one.

summary.description: The one-line description, template tokens removed.

maps.description: Data Dragon ids of the named maps the item is available on.

ItemCard.description:
An item as the list shows it, with the values its facets filter on: tags, edition, maps,
tier, price, stats.

canonicalPath.description: The page the routing redirects a stale or slugless URL to.

profile.description: The facts of the list's card, the edition and its twin among them.

description.description: Riot's rich text, unresolved template tokens removed.

availableMaps.description:
The map ids the item's availability line claims: the Classic Rift (453) alone for a
Classic item, never for a current one (UP 6).

oneOf.description: The champion only who may buy it (Kalista's Black Spear).
The ally the item needs in the team (Ornn's upgrades).
The item and its components, recursively.

ItemDetails.description:
`GET /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}/items/{id}`: the card, then the description, the
recipe, the upgrades and the champion the item is bound to, every image resolved.

tags.description: Every tag the listed items carry, as Data Dragon names them.

ItemFacets.description:
The facet options the data decides, over the whole list; the fixed ones (editions, tiers,
maps, stats) are enums of the contract or of `/api/meta`.

ItemGold.description:
Price of an item: int ItemGold.Base is the combine cost on top of the components,
int ItemGold.Total the full price.

ItemList.description:
`GET /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}/items`: the items of the encyclopedia, Classic
ones included and debris left out, in the upstream order.

gold.description: Total cost, the figure a build sums.

tags.description: Raw Data Dragon tags, the picker's filter.

ItemOption.description: An item the build editor offers in a mode.

mode.description: The mode served: an absent or unknown one falls back to the default.

ItemPicker.description:
`GET /api/pickers/items`: the items a build of the mode may carry, by name. Classic
items, those the mode's map lacks, unpurchasable, hidden and champion-bound ones are left
out (bool ItemPlayability.IsPickable(Item item, GameMode mode)).

isPercent.description: Whether double ItemStat.Value is a fraction to read as a percentage.

ItemStat.description: One non-zero row of an item stat block.

LocaleLanguage.description: An interface locale and the Data Dragon language its pages read by default.

identifier.description: The e-mail or the username, whatever the case.

rememberMe.description: Keeps the session for 30 days rather than until the browser closes.

twoFactorCode.description:
The code of the authenticator app, sent again with the password once a sign-in was
answered `two-factor-required`.

recoveryCode.description: A recovery code, in place of the authenticator's.

minimumVersion.description: Below it the app must update before use; null while there is no floor.

latestVersion.description: The newest release; null while none is published.

PlatformPolicy.description: What one app must run, and what it may update to.

combine.description: What completing it costs on top of its components.

RecipeStep.description: An item of a recipe tree, with the components it is built from.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token of the last token response.

username.description: 3 to 24 letters, digits, `_`, `.` or `-`, starting with a letter or a digit.

password.description: 12 characters or more, with a lowercase, an uppercase, a digit, a symbol.

acceptTerms.description: Acceptance of the terms of use, without which no account is created.

oneOf.description: Locale of the verification e-mail; the fallback locale when unset.
Locale of the e-mail; the fallback locale when unset.

token.description: The `token` parameter of the link, as it is.

password.description: The new password, under the rules of a new account.

ResourceType.description: The four Data Dragon resources the site catalogues, each with its own pages and paths.

shortDesc.description: Riot's rich text, unresolved template tokens removed.

tree.description: Key of its path, such as Precision.

canonicalPath.description: The page of its path: runes have none of their own.

RuneCard.description: A rune as the list shows it, with the values its facets filter on: its path and its row.

shortDesc.description: Riot's rich text, unresolved template tokens removed.

longDesc.description: Riot's rich text, unresolved template tokens removed.

RuneEntry.description: A rune on its path's page, with both of its descriptions.

contentLanguage.description: Null when the version ships no rune path at all.

total.description: Runes of the whole list, whatever the page.

trees.description: Every path, whatever the page: the path facet and its links.

RuneList.description:
`GET /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}/runes`: the runes of every path, path by path and
row by row; empty before 7.22.1, which shipped the first rune paths (UP 1).

shortDesc.description: Riot's rich text, unresolved template tokens removed.

RuneOption.description: A rune the build editor offers, in its slot.

RunePicker.description: `GET /api/pickers/runes`: every rune path in the upstream order; none before 7.22.1.

RuneRow.description: A row of a rune path: the keystones, then three rows of minor runes.

key.description: Language-independent key, such as Precision: the list filters on it.

RuneTreeCard.description: A rune path: a facet of the rune list, and a page of its own.

canonicalPath.description: The page the routing redirects a stale or slugless URL to.

RuneTreeDetails.description:
`GET /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}/runes/{id}`: a rune path and its rows, every image
resolved.

slots.description: The runes of each slot, in the upstream order.

RuneTreeOption.description: A rune path and its runes, slot by slot, keystones first.

id.description: The id its detail endpoint takes.

oneOf.description: For an item or a summoner spell, which game it belongs to.

SearchResultHit.description: An entry the search found, enough to show it and link to its page.

SearchResults.description:
`GET /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}/search`: the hits, resource by resource in the
order champions, items, runes, summoners, each in the upstream order and capped.

id.description: The id a profile stores: champion id and skin number ("Ahri_1").

number.description: Number of the skin's art, 0 for the base skin.

name.description: Display name: the base skin reads as the champion.

image.description: The loading-screen portrait, the picker's thumbnail.

banner.description: The centered splash, the profile's banner.

SkinOption.description: A skin the profile banner picker offers, its art hotlinked (UP 8).

champion.description: The champion served; null when the one asked for is unknown.

SkinPicker.description:
`GET /api/pickers/skins?champion=`: the skins of a champion, chromas left out. A
missing or unknown champion gives no skins rather than an error: the banner picker then
shows an empty choice instead of a broken dialog.

id.description: Data Dragon id, such as SummonerFlash or its Classic twin SummonerFlash_Jade.

oneOf.description: The same-named spell of the other game, when there is one.

description.description: Riot's rich text, unresolved template tokens removed.

summonerLevel.description: Summoner level that unlocks the spell.

SummonerCard.description:
A summoner spell as the list shows it, with the values its facets filter on: modes,
edition, level and cooldown.

canonicalPath.description: The page the routing redirects a stale or slugless URL to.

profile.description: The facts of the list's card, the edition and its twin among them.

costType.description: What the cost is paid in, when Data Dragon says.

range.description: Range per rank; see bool SummonerDetails.GlobalRange.

globalRange.description: Whether the range is Data Dragon's "whole map" sentinel.

SummonerDetails.description:
`GET /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}/summoners/{id}`: the card, then the cost, range
and charges, the image resolved.

modes.description: The filterable modes some spell allows, in the facet's display order.

SummonerFacets.description: The facet options the data decides, over the whole list.

SummonerList.description:
`GET /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}/summoners`: every summoner spell, Classic twins
included, in the upstream order.

code.description: Data Dragon mode, such as CLASSIC or JADE (LoL Classic).

label.description: English display name; null for a mode shown by its edition instead.

facetable.description: Whether the list's mode facet offers it.

SummonerMode.description: A queue a summoner spell is allowed in, as its plaque shows it.

SummonerOption.description: A summoner spell the build editor offers.

SummonerPicker.description:
`GET /api/pickers/summoners`: the summoner spells of the standard Summoner's Rift
queue (Data Dragon's CLASSIC mode), by name. Classic twins and event spells are left out.

identifier.description: The e-mail or the username, whatever the case.

twoFactorCode.description:
The code of the authenticator app, sent again with the password once a sign-in was
answered `two-factor-required`.

recoveryCode.description: A recovery code, in place of the authenticator's.

TokenRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/account/token`, the sign-in of the apps.

UiLocale.description: Interface locale of the site, carried as the first URL segment (`/{locale}/…`).

token.description: The `token` parameter of the link, as it is.

VerifyEmailRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/account/verify-email`: the parameters of the link.
